      public void markApplied(@Nullable Expression expression)

      Parameters:

    • showExpressionText

      public void showExpressionText()
      Show the text of the expression in place of applied text, unless the applied expression is not followed yet. The expression keeps the text it was typed as, so this only changes text that no longer reads as the expression, such as a reference whose type became known.

    • followChanges

      public static int[] followChanges(String from, String to, int[] values, int changed)
      Parameters:
      from - A text.
      to - The text after a change.
      values - A value for each character of the first text.
      changed - The value of the characters that changed.
      Returns:
      A value for each character of the second text, which is the value of the same character in the first text for the characters before and after the change.

    • sync

      public void sync(Expression expression, @Nullable String text, Supplier<List<ExpressionPrinter.Token>> printer)
      Follow the given expression. A draft is kept, and is compared to the new expression from now on. Applied text is kept if this is the expression it was applied as, and is replaced by the text of the expression otherwise.
      Parameters:
      expression - The current expression.
      text - The text it was typed as, or null if it is printed.
      printer - Gives the text of the expression as tokens, only called when the expression or its text changed.

    • render

      public void render(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics guiGraphics, int x, int y, int width, int height, int[] colors, int[] backgrounds, int mark, int markEnd, int markColor)
      Parameters:
      guiGraphics - The graphics.
      x - The left of the text.
      y - The top of the text.
      width - The width of the text, including room for a scrollbar.
      height - The height of the text.
      colors - The color of each character.
      backgrounds - The background of each character, or 0 for none.
      mark - The first character to underline, such as where an error is, or -1.
      markEnd - The character after the last one to underline, which is at least the first one.
      markColor - The color of the underline.

    • renderErrorTooltip

      public void renderErrorTooltip(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics guiGraphics, int position, int end, net.minecraft.network.chat.Component message, int mouseX, int mouseY)
      Show the message of an error in a tooltip while the mouse is over its line, with an arrow at its position, as in Integrated Scripting's editor. Not while the list is shown, which is what is being typed in, and in place of the signature of the call at the cursor, which it would cover. Called after the text is drawn.
      Parameters:
      guiGraphics - The graphics.
      position - Where the error is.
      end - The character after the part with the error, which is at least the position.
      message - The message.
      mouseX - The x position of the mouse.
      mouseY - The y position of the mouse.

    • renderPartTooltip

      public void renderPartTooltip(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics guiGraphics, int start, int end, net.minecraft.network.chat.Component message, int mouseX, int mouseY)
      Show the message of an error of a part of the text in a tooltip while the mouse is over that part, with an arrow at the part on the row of the mouse, as for renderErrorTooltip(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics, int, int, net.minecraft.network.chat.Component, int, int).
      Parameters:
      guiGraphics - The graphics.
      start - The first character of the part.
      end - The character after the part.
      message - The message.
      mouseX - The x position of the mouse.
      mouseY - The y position of the mouse.

    • renderPopups

      public void renderPopups(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics guiGraphics)
      Draw the list shown while typing, or the signature of the call at the cursor, if the text was drawn since. This is done after everything else, as slots and labels are drawn without depth, so they would cover them.
      Parameters:
      guiGraphics - The graphics, without translation.
